records.note: The phrase is in the Byzantine majority and the Textus Receptus but not in Sinaiticus, Vaticanus or most early witnesses; the ASV follows the latter. Redemption through Christ's blood is still stated in Ephesians 1:7.
The earliest manuscripts end the greeting at "God our Father"; the Textus Receptus adds "and the Lord Jesus Christ", as in Paul's other greetings.
